description: Cross-cultural adaptation layer for Brand Archetype OS — Jungian 12-archetype diagnostic with 4D vector model (control, energy, focus, method). Covers Russian (RU), English (EN), and Arabic (AR) locales with culturally-appropriate metaphor substitutions, RTL visual rules, and per-locale visual benchmarks.

typography_rules.description: Per-locale typography, RTL, and layout rules that override the base LTR system.

border_radius.description: In RTL, the visual origin is top-right. Corner rounding hierarchy starts from top-right clockwise. border-radius shorthand adjusts: top-left ↔ top-right swap in visual intent.

shorthand_remapping.all_four: top-right top-left bottom-left bottom-right (visual origin shift)
shorthand_remapping.note: When --radius-sm/--radius-md/--radius-lg are asymmetrical, the larger radius should lead from top-right in RTL.

box_shadow.description: Horizontal offset must flip sign for RTL. Light source assumed from top-left in LTR becomes top-right in RTL.

examples.slide_in: @keyframes slide-in { from { transform: translateX(100%); } to { transform: translateX(0); } }
examples.fade_in: transform-origin defaults to top right instead of top left
examples.scan_line: Scan sweeps from right to left instead of left to right

padding_margin.description: Logical properties preferred over physical. Use padding-inline-start/end instead of padding-left/right.

arabic_specific.font_stack: 'Tajawal', 'Noto Naskh Arabic', 'Scheherazade New', 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', system-ui, sans-serif
arabic_specific.letter_spacing: normal — Arabic is cursive; do not add letter-spacing

calligraphic_considerations.headings: Thuluth or Diwani-inspired weight for ornamental headings

number_rendering.preference: Arabic-Indic digits (٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩) for fully localized AR; Western Arabic (0123456789) for mixed technical contexts
number_rendering.default: Western Arabic numerals for technical consistency

considerations.cyrillic_italics: Cyrillic italics differ significantly from upright forms; ensure font supports Cyrillic italic glyphs
considerations.capitalization: Russian typography uses less ALL-CAPS than English; prefer bold weight over uppercase for emphasis

considerations.headings: Title case or ALL-CAPS acceptable for headings
considerations.quotes: Use “curly quotes” as primary, 'single quotes' for nested

negative_space_cultural_logic.description: The core insight about how 'air' / negative space functions differently across visual cultures, directly affecting spacing, ornamentation density, and layout strategy.

european_ltr.principle: Negative space = breathing room. Emptiness is functional, allowing content to be parsed. Minimalism = removal.
european_ltr.spacing_strategy: Generous whitespace, content isolation, clear separation
european_ltr.density: Low-to-medium content density; each element deserves its own space

arabic_rtl.principle: Negative space = canvas for geometric ornament. Emptiness is not 'breathing room' — it is a surface awaiting arabesque, pattern, or calligraphic elaboration. The void is a field of potential beauty.
arabic_rtl.spacing_strategy: Space serves pattern. Gaps between elements may carry geometric fill (arabesque lines, star-polygon tessellations, vine-scroll motifs). What a European designer would leave empty, an Arab visual tradition fills with intricate geometry.
arabic_rtl.ornamentation: Integral — ornament IS the structure, not decoration added atop it. The pattern and the object are one.
arabic_rtl.density: Higher acceptable ornamental density — but balanced by geometric order (not chaos). Complexity through tessellation, not clutter.
arabic_rtl.design_implication: When localizing for AR, DO NOT simply flip direction and keep European minimalism. The Ruler archetype in AR demands intricate geometry where EN/RU Ruler would use a single gold line. The 'air' must be reconsidered as ornamental surface.

implementation_notes.description: Guidance for engineers implementing this cross-cultural layer in the Brand Archetype OS codebase.

locale_detection.method: navigator.language first, then user preference override

vector_math.note: All delta vectors in question_adaptations are mathematically identical across locales. The cultural adaptation changes only the text and metaphor, never the diagnostic math.

pivot_integration.note: When Pivot.execute() runs, it should consult this file's visual_benchmarks_per_locale for the active locale and apply locale-specific CSS overrides on top of ArchetypeThemes.

css_generation.note: For RTL (ar), generate an additional CSS block with [dir='rtl'] or html[lang='ar'] selector overrides. Use CSS logical properties (margin-inline-start, padding-inline-end, etc.) throughout the codebase to minimize RTL-specific overrides.

font_loading.arabic: Load Tajawal (Google Fonts) as primary AR sans-serif. Load Noto Naskh Arabic as serif fallback. Preload both for performance.
font_loading.russian: Ensure Manrope and Inter include Cyrillic subsets. Add 'cyrillic' to Google Fonts load URL.
font_loading.english: Standard Manrope + Inter stack — no special subset needed.
